scope: Repair the rejected Companion Open canvas implementation; unrelated Desk and shared voice edits preserved.

Old card padding and diagnostic-style copy remained after removing the cards.
Settings duplicated large model/profile editors instead of using the existing pickers.
Large-text sorting/filter rows split action labels across letters.
Long Git paths hid the actual filename; branch strings fragmented into many lines.
The New chat label inherited a pale text color on an accent background.
The old three-row large-text bottom navigation consumed excessive vertical space.
The chat scroll indicator appeared as a bright rail even when content fit.
Reasoning/model text actions added a separate tall row to the focused composer.

Hosts and Device rebuilt as aligned sections with bounded trailing actions and settings rows.
Settings links to existing model/profile flows and keeps speech/background preferences together.
Conversation sorting and filters use menus; whole action controls reflow at large text sizes.

Large-text navigation keeps the center Voice dock and selected label; other destinations keep accessible names and touch targets.
Material typography inherits component content colors; New chat explicitly uses dark foreground.
